dedupe_keys.name: a dataset of gridded precipitation intensity duration frequency curves in qinghai tibet plateau

description: A dataset of gridded precipitation intensity-duration-frequency curves in Qinghai-Tibet Plateau is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Zhihui Ren et al. Destructive rainstorms and the resulting natural disasters in the high mountain area of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau (QTP) motivate development of precipitation intensity-duration-frequency (IDF) curves for estimating extreme precipitation characteristics. Here we introduce the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau Precipitation Intensity-Duration-Frequency Curves (QTPPIDFC) dataset, the first gridded dataset tailored for estimating extreme precipitation characteristics in QTP. Coverage: not stated; published in 2025. Formats: TXT. The only repository address found in the article is the code repository in Zenodo named in its Code Availability section; the data may be hosted elsewhere, as the Data Records section of the article states. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
